aiResearchSummary.text: Zitara Technologies is engaged in research and development of systems and methods for determining battery condition, as described in 'System and method for determining a battery condition,' which involves using sensor measurements and state estimators to assess battery state. Their work also includes a 'Battery analysis system and method' that selects state estimator operation settings based on system inputs to determine battery state. These efforts focus on predictive battery management for electric fleets.
